latest.name: Lumi Launcher v0.7.0 (Pre-release)
latest.body:
## English

First public pre-release following Mojang's official AppID allowlist approval — ready for official Minecraft: Java Edition sign-in and play out of the box.

> **Note:** Official Microsoft sign-in is now live. Found a bug or have feedback? Let us know on [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/kokoa-77/LumiLauncher/issues/new/choose).
>
> NOT AN OFFICIAL MINECRAFT PRODUCT. NOT APPROVED BY OR ASSOCIATED WITH MOJANG OR MICROSOFT.

### ✨ What's Changed
- 🔐 **Login System v2 & Official Skin/Cape Studio** — Upgraded to OAuth 2.1 + PKCE with native Passkey / Windows Hello support, sign-in progress feedback, Account Security Center, session pre-warming, and a built-in official 3D Skin & Cape Studio.
- ⚡ **Next-Gen Official Download Engine** — Rebuilt official-source downloads with multi-segment acceleration, adaptive concurrency, resumable transfers, RFC 8484 DoH, live proxy watching, and a real-time Task Center cockpit.
- 🕰️ **Full Version Matrix & Legacy Loaders** — Expanded support to Release, Snapshot, April Fools, and Beta/Alpha versions, adding Legacy Forge (1.5.2–1.12.2), Legacy Fabric, and Babric alongside Fabric, NeoForge, Forge, and Quilt.
- 📦 **Complete Modpack Lifecycle** — Added MultiMC / Prism `.zip` import (`patches/*.json`), an instance version/loader upgrade wizard (in-place or cloned), 3-way lossless modpack updates with one-click rollback, and 4-format export with privacy filters.
- 🛡️ **Visual Safety Net & Instance Notes** — Added a visual change & launch timeline with one-click rollback, reverse mod dependency hints with orphan cleanup, and per-instance notes.
- 🌐 **New Official Website** — Now live at [https://lumilauncher.org](https://lumilauncher.org), with updated privacy, security, and license documentation.

---

## 简体中文

通过 Mojang 官方 AppID 白名单审核后的首个公开内测版本，安装后开箱即可使用正版 Microsoft 账户登录并游玩 Minecraft: Java Edition。

> **说明：** 官方 Microsoft 正版登录现已正式可用。内测期间如遇问题或有建议，欢迎前往 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/kokoa-77/LumiLauncher/issues/new/choose) 反馈。
>
> 非 Minecraft 官方产品。未经 Mojang 或 Microsoft 批准，也不与 Mojang 或 Microsoft 关联。

### ✨ 本次更新
- 🔐 **登录系统 v2 与官方 3D 皮肤披风工坊** — 升级至 OAuth 2.1 + PKCE 双栈回环流程，原生支持系统浏览器 Passkey / Windows Hello，新增登录进度提示、账户安全中心、短时会话预热及内置官方 3D 皮肤与披风工坊。
- ⚡ **新一代官方源下载引擎** — 重构官方源下载链路，支持大文件分段并发加速、自适应并发调度、断点续传、RFC 8484 DoH、系统代理实时监听与全新实时任务驾驶舱。
- 🕰️ **全版本矩阵与怀旧加载器** — 覆盖正式版、快照、愚人节版本与远古 Beta / Alpha，并在 Fabric、NeoForge、Forge、Quilt 之外新增 Legacy Forge（1.5.2–1.12.2）、Legacy Fabric 与 Babric。
- 📦 **整合包全生命周期升级** — 新增 MultiMC / Prism `.zip` 导入（含 `patches/*.json` 补丁引擎）、实例版本/加载器升级向导（支持原地或克隆升级）、三方比对无损整合包更新与一键回滚，以及 4 格式导出与隐私项过滤。
- 🛡️ **可视化改动时间线与实例笔记** — 改动快照与启动记录融合展示支持一键回滚，新增模组反向依赖提示与孤儿前置清理，以及每实例独立的实例笔记。
- 🌐 **全新官方网站上线** — 官方域名 [https://lumilauncher.org/zh/](https://lumilauncher.org/zh/) 正式启用，同步更新隐私、安全与许可文档。

releases.name: Lumi Launcher v0.6.4 (Pre-review Build)
releases.body:
## English

Pre-review build for source verification and Mojang AppID allowlist review (`<app-id>`).

> **Note:** Clicking **Sign in** launches the official Microsoft OAuth 2.0 + PKCE flow in your system browser and stops at the expected `403` Minecraft Services gate until Mojang approves Lumi's AppID. You can already explore instances, worlds, Modrinth discovery, and settings.
>
> NOT AN OFFICIAL MINECRAFT PRODUCT. NOT APPROVED BY OR ASSOCIATED WITH MOJANG OR MICROSOFT.

### What's Changed
- Connected all Minecraft game files, metadata, Java runtimes, mod loaders, and mod platforms directly to official endpoints only, removing all built-in third-party mirrors.
- Streamlined network connectivity diagnostics to probe core official endpoints only.
- Configured official pre-review builds with Lumi's Microsoft Entra public client ID (`<app-id>`) and public maintainer contact (`lumilauncher@outlook.com`).

### Verification
Verify downloaded files against `SHA256SUMS.txt`:
`Get-FileHash .\LumiLauncher_0.6.4_x64-setup.exe -Algorithm SHA256`

---

## 简体中文

面向源码核验与 Mojang AppID 白名单审核的预审构建（客户端 ID：`<app-id>`）。

> **说明：** 点击「登录」会正常拉起系统浏览器的官方 Microsoft OAuth 2.0 + PKCE 授权流程，并在 Mojang 批准 Lumi 的 AppID 白名单前按预期停在 Minecraft Services 的 `403` 校验门禁。在此期间你已可完整体验界面、管理实例与存档、浏览 Modrinth 并检查各项设置。
>
> 非 Minecraft 官方产品。未经 Mojang 或 Microsoft 批准，也不与 Mojang 或 Microsoft 关联。

### 本次更新
- 游戏本体、元数据、Java 运行时、模组加载器与模组平台全链路改为仅直连官方源，移除全部内置第三方镜像。
- 网络连通性诊断精简为仅探测核心官方服务端点。
- 官方预审构建已配置 Lumi 的 Microsoft Entra 公共客户端 ID（`<app-id>`）与公开维护者联系邮箱（`lumilauncher@outlook.com`）。

### 文件校验
下载后请对照同页面的 `SHA256SUMS.txt` 核验文件完整性：
`Get-FileHash .\LumiLauncher_0.6.4_x64-setup.exe -Algorithm SHA256`
